title: Software Engineer, Data Science (Intern)
job_description: Intro Based in Singapore, the Data Science Intern will develop and apply machine learning and computer vision techniques to extract actionable insights from data collected by inspection and NDT tools, helping to advance the company's software products and solutions. What will you do Develop tools to process the high volume of information collected by cameras and NDT tools (e.g Ground Penetrating Radar) Uncover hidden data correlations in aforementioned data (e.g. presence of corrosion vs concrete cover vs geographical location) Improve existing software tools using data science Discover, learn and apply state-of-the-art Machine Learning techniques to InspectionTech problems. Leverage data science techniques to improve customer insights in the InspectionTech space. Support project lifecycles from brainstorming to production Contribute to developing cutting-edge software and solutions that add value to the company and its customers. What do we expect Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related fields. Knowledge in Machine Learning libraries such as PyTorch. Knowledge in Computer Vision libraries such as OpenCV. Knowledge in Python and neural network frameworks (Pytorch, TensorFlow). About us We are on a mission to protect the built world with software, sensors and data. We hire talented problem-solvers with bold ambition who share our passion for inspection technology to sustain mission-critical assets and infrastructure for future generations. Our culture is creative, innovative and inclusive. We are a fast-paced, product driven, growth company headquartered in Switzerland with our Singapore and Malaga technology hub and a global mindset looking to lead a digital revolution in inspection. Want to join the #EagleTeam?
